title: the argument, the read-state contract, and the team that runs it
summary: First release. The thesis that feeds are replaceable and reading is not, read-state/v1 published as a contract before any implementation, the vault layout, the build order, and the seven-role dev team the site is run by — generated from the ROLE.md files rather than described beside them. Nothing is served yet: the subdomain does not resolve (board card 004).
